description: Extracts structured holiday tables (Gazetted and Restricted) from staffnews.in Central Government holiday lists with S. No., Holiday name, Date, Saka Date, and Day.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_gazetted_holidays: Fetches the 2025 Gazetted Holidays list; 参数: 无; 必填: 无
  - get_restricted_holidays: Fetches the 2025 Restricted Holidays list; 参数: 无; 必填: 无
  - get_holiday_page: Fetches a specific holiday page URL and extracts tables; 参数: url; 必填: url

url.description: URL of a specific holiday page to fetch. Required when function is 'get_holiday_page'. Used by: get_holiday_page
